1970: "The agency was known as the United States Weather Bureau from 1891 until it adopted its current name in 1970."

1970: "The Environmental Science Services Administration was renamed the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) on October 1, 1970, with the enactment of the National Environmental Policy Act."
